blocked.E2: `E2_local` is present on every record but its producer is not in the estate — it appears in no ingestion module. Provenance must be established before it can feed a published score (M-052 precedent).
blocked.I2: wind speed — NOT in the cached ERA5 baseline (fields are lat/lon/t_mean_c/heat_days/ice_days across all 39 countries)
blocked.I4: grid-geo lines exist (sharded as grid-geo-l-NN.json for germany, france, us) but grid-geo's substation ID space diverges from the fleet, and differently per country: italy matches exactly, poland is prefix-only (225674207 vs PL_225674207), greece is positional (0,1,2 vs GR-ADMIE-0000), uk does not match at all. A line-to-unit join needs per-country ID reconciliation first — Convention #80 grid-geo is not uniformly joinable to ssi-data.
blocked.I9: flood hazard layer (shares its input with S2)
blocked.S2: flood hazard layer (as implemented) or true RPF data
blocked.T1: S1_raw, DER variability, EV load ratio
blocked.V1: SAIDI; V_socio is already present at 100% coverage

proxy_notes.I1: ice_days (T_max < 0 °C day count) substituted for the construct's HDD_annual/10000. A frost-day count is a more direct ice-loading proxy than heating degree-days, but it is still a proxy — see the metric implementation disclosure.
proxy_notes.I3: heat_days (T_max > 25 °C day count) substituted for the construct's CDD_annual/2000.
proxy_notes.I6: Counted from the ssi-data fleet itself, NOT from grid-geo — the authoritative substation set, and it sidesteps the ID-space divergence that blocks I4. The unit is `region`, matching the construct's 'count in the unit'. Records carrying no region get no I6 rather than a default, so the component refuses to roll up for them.
